newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Jordanian military team holds talks in Bahrain.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian military team holds talks in Bahrain.

text.p: A Jordanian military team on Sunday held talks in Bahrain on ways of boosting security cooperation between the two Arab countries.

The Gulf News Agency said the team met Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa who expressed the island's willingness to strengthen ties and cooperation with Jordan, mainly in the fields of security and military.
It gave no further details but said Sheikh Isa also praised the policies of Jordan's King Hussein "in serving Arab and Islamic causes".
Bahrain, the Gulf's main financial and banking centre, is facing sporadic civil unrest by its majority Shi'ite Moslem community seeking political and economic reforms by the Sunni-led government.
